newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKW Trostberg expects EPS of 2.20 DM in '96.
newsitem.headline: SKW Trostberg expects EPS of 2.20 DM in '96.

text.p: German specialty chemicals group SKW Trostberg AG said on Wednesday it expects its 1996 earnings per share (EPS) to be at least 2.20 marks, compared to 2.03 marks in 1995.

"We expect an EPS of at least 2.20 marks and we expect operating profit to outpace sales growth in 1997," SKW Trostberg chief financial officer Klaus-Juergen Schulz said at the announcement of the group's nine-month results.
Shulz said: "The acquisition of Master Builders Technologies (MBT) will help EPS to be higher in 1997. However, goodwill from the acquisition of MBT will weigh on net profit next year."
Earlier the company said nine month sales climbed four percent while operating profits were at year-ago levels.
